svg.text: Salary aayi, Ravi ko 20,000 rent bheja, SMS service giri hui thi
PEHLE: transfer karte hi SMS bhejne jaate the
transfer ho gaya, par SMS kabhi nahi gaya
AB: DB me ek aur table "outbox": SMS ki chitthi bhi usi transaction me likho
DB gira to bhi chitthi outbox me: kuch nahi khota
PHIR? "Pehle Kafka me daal do, DB me baad me likho — outbox kyun?"
chitthi tabhi nikle jab paisa pakka gaya
